import sys

def solve(data):
    it = iter(data)
    out = []

    for token in it:
        n = int(token)
        if n == 0:
            break

        # DP arrays:
        # vertical[j]   = consecutive 1s ending at current row, column j, vertically
        # diag1[j]      = consecutive 1s ending at current row, column j, main diagonal (\)
        # diag2[j]      = consecutive 1s ending at current row, column j, anti-diagonal (/)
        vertical = [0] * n
        prev_diag1 = [0] * n
        prev_diag2 = [0] * n

        best = 0

        for _ in range(n):
            curr_diag1 = [0] * n
            curr_diag2 = [0] * n
            horizontal = 0

            for j in range(n):
                x = int(next(it))
                if x == 1:
                    horizontal += 1
                    vertical[j] += 1
                    curr_diag1[j] = 1 + (prev_diag1[j - 1] if j > 0 else 0)
                    curr_diag2[j] = 1 + (prev_diag2[j + 1] if j + 1 < n else 0)

                    if horizontal > best:
                        best = horizontal
                    if vertical[j] > best:
                        best = vertical[j]
                    if curr_diag1[j] > best:
                        best = curr_diag1[j]
                    if curr_diag2[j] > best:
                        best = curr_diag2[j]
                else:
                    horizontal = 0
                    vertical[j] = 0
                    curr_diag1[j] = 0
                    curr_diag2[j] = 0

            prev_diag1 = curr_diag1
            prev_diag2 = curr_diag2

        out.append(str(best))

    return "\n".join(out)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    print(solve(data))
